question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Accelerate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Downsize.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"accelerate"** means to increase in speed or go faster. (त्वरित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The car began to accelerate as it entered the highway.
 
 
 
• **"Downsize"** refers to reducing in size, number, or extent. (कमी करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company had to downsize its workforce due to the economic downturn.
